verdict.rationale: SigNoz's own docs mention exception tracking and error analysis, which is the core of this story. That is a single navigation-level mention with no detail on how errors are grouped or displayed. The deploy-investigation item is an AI-assistant use case, not a release-tracking feature, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented grouping of errors into issues, stack-trace views, release/version tracking, regression detection, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection

citations.quote: Configure exception tracking and error analysis
